E20FX.NeedsSequencer: Essence20 FX needs the Sequencer module: turn it on in Manage Modules.
E20FX.NoJB2A: Essence20 FX: no JB2A animation pack is active, so only sounds will play. Install "JB2A - Free Content" for the animations.

Enabled.Name: Play effects
Enabled.Hint: Animations and sounds for the whole table. Each player can still turn them off for themselves in Sequencer's settings.

Combat.Name: Attack effects
Combat.Hint: A projectile or swing, an impact, and a sound for every attack - in the look of its damage type - and a burst for area attacks.

Damage.Name: Damage and Defeat effects
Damage.Hint: A token flashes and shakes when it takes damage, and a Defeated one gets a puff of smoke and a skull.

Conditions.Name: Condition effects
Conditions.Hint: A short icon and sound when a token gains a Condition: Stunned stars, Frightened, Poisoned, Prone, chains for Grappled...

Signature.Name: Morph, Transform and Zord effects
Signature.Hint: Morphing in the Ranger's own colour, Transforming, Energon, Zords arriving, boarding and being recalled, Megazords and Combiners forming and breaking apart.

Extras.Name: Story Point, Spellcasting and teamwork effects
Extras.Hint: Story Points spent, Spellcasting sparkles in the caster's colour, the Weird's static, help from a teammate (hearts in My Little Pony), rerolls (fireworks for ponies), and Requisitions arriving.

Volume.Name: Effect volume
Volume.Hint: How loud the effect sounds play (each player's Interface volume applies on top).

ReducedMotion.Name: Reduced motion
ReducedMotion.Hint: Hear the effect sounds but don't see the animations. Just for you.

Ambient.Name: Lasting effects
Ambient.Hint: Effects that stay while a state lasts: a Morphed Ranger's aura, a Zord's dust, a Megazord's glow, Defeated smoke, and markers for Stunned, Poisoned, Frightened, Deafened and held.

AmbientActive.Name: Ring on the active combatant
AmbientActive.Hint: A ring under the token whose turn it is.

EmblemFlash.Name: Faction emblem flash
EmblemFlash.Hint: The emblem flashes up on a Morph, a Transform, and a Megazord or Combiner forming.

EmblemsOnDice.Name: Faction emblems on dice
EmblemsOnDice.Hint: With Dice So Nice: a d20 per faction whose 20 shows its emblem, in each player's Dice So Nice dice choices. Takes effect after a reload.

DiceAutoColour.Name: Dice in my character's colours
DiceAutoColour.Hint: With Dice So Nice: your character's rolls use their colours - a Ranger's, their faction's, or their line's. Just for you.

SceneAmbience.Name: Scene ambience
SceneAmbience.Hint: Play the loop each scene's Configuration picks (its Environment tab): Night Vale static, Energon motes, sparkles, fog, battlefield smoke, wind, fireflies.

EmblemOnCards.Name: Faction emblems on roll cards
EmblemOnCards.Hint: A character's faction emblem beside their name on their roll cards in chat.

AttackAnimator.Name: Attack animations by
AttackAnimator.Hint: Only with the Automated Animations module active. It has no Essence20 support of its own; this hands it each attack (who, with what, at whom, which hit). "When it has one" uses its animation for an item it's set up for - its own settings on the item (the item sheet's Automated Animations button), or a name its Automatic Recognition knows - and Essence20 FX's otherwise. Area attacks, and everything that isn't an attack, stay with Essence20 FX.
AttackAnimator.AaFirst: Automated Animations when it has one, else Essence20 FX

AutorecSounds.Name: Sounds on the Automated Animations entries
AutorecSounds.Hint: The Essence20 entries added to Automated Animations play this module's sounds (applies the next time they're added).

EmblemBadge.Name: Faction badges on tokens
EmblemBadge.Hint: Each token wears its faction's emblem as a small badge on its top-left corner (set the images in Faction Emblems).

EmblemTurnMarkers.Name: Faction turn markers
EmblemTurnMarkers.Hint: Each token's turn marker (the image under the token whose turn it is) becomes its faction's marker image, where one is set in Faction Emblems. A turn marker someone picked for a token by hand is left alone.

Config.Title: Configure FX
Config.Hint: Change or turn off the animation and sound of any effect, preview it, and export or import the lot.
Config.Intro: Change what any effect plays. Leave a field empty to keep the module's own (shown greyed). An animation is a Sequencer database path (jb2a....) or a file; a sound is a file, or "none" for silence. Preview plays it just for you, on the selected token (and the targeted one, for an attack).
Config.IntroActor: This character's own effects, played over the GM's. Leave a field empty to keep the table's. Preview plays it just for you.
Config.ColorHint: Used for Morphing and Spellcasting instead of the sheet colour - a hex colour like #ff2266. Empty uses the sheet's.
Config.Imported: Read {count} changed effects from the file - Save to keep them.
Config.ImportBad: That file isn't an Essence20 FX export.
Config.PreviewNeedsToken: Select a token to preview on.
Config.PreviewNeedsTarget: Target another token to preview an attack.
Config.FactionHint: Which of the GM's faction emblems this character wears. Automatic follows its Faction item, then its folder.

Moment.attack-area-critical: Area: Critical Success on a target

Emblems.Title: Faction Emblems
Emblems.Hint: Your own images for each faction: a badge on its tokens' corner, a flash on a Morph or Transform, its turn marker, roll cards, dice.
Emblems.Intro: The module ships no faction symbols - they belong to Hasbro - but you can use your own. Each faction can have an emblem and a turn marker. A character wears its Faction item's, else its folder's, else the one picked in its Effects window. "Import folder" fills the rows from a folder whose files are named for them: cobra.png for the emblem, cobra-marker.png for the turn marker. Tint colours the emblem (leave it empty to keep its own colours).
Emblems.Imported: Matched {count} images to factions ({unmatched} didn't match a name).
Emblems.EmblemSpec: A badge on the token's corner (a third of its width), the flash on a Morph or Transform, roll cards and dice. Square, {ideal} px, transparent background (PNG or WebP); at least {min} px. Keep it bold and simple - it shows small.
Emblems.MarkerSpec: Foundry's own marker under the token whose turn it is. Foundry draws it square at 1.5x the token, under the token - so only the outer ring shows - and spins it. Square, {ideal} x {ideal} px (Foundry's own are 512), transparent; {min} to {max} px. Put the design in the outer band - a ring, or the symbol repeated around it.
Emblems.BadgePreview: How the badge sits on a token
Emblems.MarkerPreview: How the turn marker shows: the grey disc is the token covering its middle

Advice.badgeNotSquare: not square - it keeps its shape, so it shows smaller, with a gap above and below or at the sides.
Advice.markerNotSquare: not square - Foundry stretches a turn marker to a square, so it will look squashed.
Advice.tooSmall: small - it may look blurry (use at least {min} px).
Advice.tooBig: bigger than it needs to be ({ideal} px is plenty).
Advice.opaque: a JPEG can't be transparent, so it shows as a box - use PNG or WebP.

SceneAmbience.Label: Essence20 FX ambience
SceneAmbience.Hint: A loop over the whole scene, for everyone (a player's Reduced motion keeps it off their screen). Needs JB2A.

Looks.nightvale: Night Vale: violet haze and static

Autorec.Title: Essence20 weapons for Automated Animations
Autorec.Hint: Adds Automatic Recognition entries for the words Essence20 weapon names use - Blaster, Laser, Rifle, Pistol, Cannon, Grenade, Launcher, Blade, Saber, Bludgeon, Claw and more - to Automated Animations' menus. Your own entries are never replaced. Needs Automated Animations.
Autorec.Confirm: Add Automatic Recognition entries for Essence20 weapons (Blaster, Laser, Rifle, Pistol, Cannon, Grenade, Launcher, Blade, Saber, Bludgeon, Claw and more) to Automated Animations? Only entries whose names its menus don't have yet are added; yours stay as they are. You can edit or delete them in its Automatic Recognition menu.
Autorec.Added: Added {count} Essence20 entries to Automated Animations.

E20FX.LegacySystem: Essence20 FX: this world runs Essence20 {version}. Attacks, damage, Defeat, Conditions, Morph, Transform, Energon, Megazords forming and Story Points play; area bursts, Zords arriving and leaving, Megazords breaking apart, Requisitions, rerolls and help from a teammate need Essence20 6.0.5.
